```{=html}
<!-- DRAFT B: by player. A rail down the left holds the transport and everything about the tune and the practice loop. Beside it
     the chart, then one card for each player with all of that player's settings and its fader, mute and solo; then the settings
     that belong to the whole band, the tone controls, and the seldom-used panels folded shut. See _bt-draft-common.qmd. -->
<style>
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:17rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:1rem;align-items:start}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail{position:sticky;top:72px;max-height:calc(100vh - 80px);overflow-y:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.55rem .6rem;align-items:end;
  padding:.8rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:10px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff)}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>*{min-width:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>.dxb-w,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>.dx-h,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>p,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>details{grid-column:1 / -1}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail>.dx-h{margin:.5rem 0 0;padding-top:.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail select,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-play,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-btn{width:100%;max-width:100%}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-inline{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem .5rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-inline select{flex:1 1 100%}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-status,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-hint{margin:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-hint:empty{display:none}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-beats{height:1.2rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-check{white-space:normal}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail .bt-info{margin-top:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-main>*:first-child{margin-top:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-players{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem;margin-top:1rem;align-items:stretch}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-card{flex:1 1 15rem;min-width:0;margin-top:0;display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:flex-start}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-card.dxb-drums{flex:2 1 30rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-card>.dx-strip{flex:0 0 4rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-card>.dx-strip input[type=range].dx-v{height:11rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body select,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body input[type=range]:not(.dx-v){width:100%;max-width:100%}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body .bt-more,#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body .bt-info{margin-top:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-body .bt-morelist{grid-template-columns:1fr}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(8rem,1fr));gap:.5rem .6rem;align-items:end}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-card .bt-row{margin:0;gap:.4rem .6rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-band .bt-sub{margin:0;padding:0;border:0}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-band .bt-sub>h3{display:none}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-tone{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem 2rem;align-items:flex-start}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-tone>*{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-tone .bt-row{margin:0 0 .5rem}
#bt-root.dxb .dxb-tone #bt-amp{margin-top:.8rem}
@media (max-width:900px){
  #bt-root.dxb .dxb-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  #bt-root.dxb .dxb-rail{position:static;max-height:none}
}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var D = window.BTDraft, $ = D.$, el = D.el, F = D.field;
  if (!D || !D.player) return;                                          // (the band did not load: the page says so itself)
  var root = D.init("dxb", "B (a card for each player)", [["backing-track.html", "The current page"], ["backing-track-a.html", "Draft A"]]);
  var old = root.querySelector(".bt-panel"), band = $("bt-sec-band"), subs = band.querySelectorAll(":scope > .bt-sub"), mix = $("bt-sec-mix");
  var grid = el("div", "dxb-grid"), rail = el("div", "dxb-rail"), main = el("div", "dxb-main");
  function wide(node){ if (node) node.classList.add("dxb-w"); return node; }
  function box(text){ var d = el("div", "bt-field"); d.appendChild(el("span", "bt-group-label", text)); return d; }

  // ---- the rail: transport, the tune, the form, practice, and what is pressed while playing ----
  var fillF = F("bt-fill"), startF = F("bt-start"), stepF = F("bt-step-on");
  D.put(rail, wide($("bt-play")), wide($("bt-beats")), wide($("bt-status")), wide($("bt-loop-note")),
    fillF, wide($("bt-sections-field")),
    D.head("Tune"), F("bt-tempo-n"), F("bt-key"), wide(F("bt-changes")), wide(F("bt-style")), F("bt-meter"), F("bt-feel"), wide(F("bt-timefeel")), wide($("bt-timeparts-field")),
    D.head("Form"), F("bt-countin"), F("bt-choruses"), wide(F("bt-intro")), wide($("bt-intro-more")),
    D.head("Practice"), wide(F("bt-cyc-on")), startF, wide(stepF), $("bt-practice").querySelector("details.bt-info"));
  old.hidden = true; $("bt-practice").hidden = true;

  // ---- the main column: chart, players, whole band, tone, the rest ----
  var keep = ["bt-remote", "bt-pinnote", "bt-tabstrip"].map($).concat([root.querySelector(".bt-chartrow"), $("bt-barwarn")]);
  keep.forEach(function(n){ main.appendChild(n); });

  var players = el("div", "dxb-players");
  function card(part, title, cls){
    var c = el("div", "bt-panel dxb-card" + (cls ? " " + cls : "")), body = el("div", "dxb-body"), h = D.head(title);
    c.appendChild(F("bt-vol-" + part)); c.appendChild(body); body.appendChild(h); players.appendChild(c); c.body = body; return c;
  }
  var cBass = card("bass", "Bass"), cComp = card("comp", "Chords"), cSecond = card("comp2", "Second chords"), cDrums = card("drums", "Drums", "dxb-drums");
  D.put(cBass.body, F("bt-bass"), F("bt-bass-sound"), F("bt-oct-bass"), $("bt-walk-field"));
  D.put(cComp.body, F("bt-comp"), F("bt-oct-comp"), F("bt-rhythm"), $("bt-rhythm-more"), F("bt-voicing"), $("bt-voicing-more"), F("bt-vmove"), F("bt-ext"), $("bt-ext-more"), subs[2].querySelector(":scope > details.bt-info"));
  D.put(cSecond.body, F("bt-second"), $("bt-second-rhythm-f"), $("bt-second-voicing-f"), $("bt-oct-comp2-f"), $("bt-second-suggest"));
  var two = el("div", "dxb-two"); D.put(two, F("bt-groove"), F("bt-fills"));
  D.put(cDrums.body, two, $("bt-kit"));
  // the second chord player has no fader until an instrument is chosen: say so where the fader will be
  main.appendChild(players);

  var whole = el("div", "bt-panel dxb-band"); D.put(whole, D.head("Whole band"), subs[0]); main.appendChild(whole);

  var tone = el("div", "bt-panel"), toneRow = el("div", "dxb-tone"); tone.id = "dxb-tone";
  $("bt-eq").insertBefore(D.head("Tone (EQ)"), $("bt-eq").firstChild);
  $("bt-organ").insertBefore(D.head("Organ"), $("bt-organ").firstChild);
  D.put(toneRow, $("bt-eq"), $("bt-organ")); tone.appendChild(toneRow); main.appendChild(tone);

  [$("bt-sec-chart"), $("bt-notation"), $("bt-setups"), $("bt-export"), root.querySelector("details.bt-abc"), root.querySelector("details.bt-about")].forEach(function(d){ d.open = false; main.appendChild(d); });
  band.hidden = true; mix.hidden = true;
  grid.appendChild(rail); grid.appendChild(main); root.appendChild(grid);

  D.partStrips(false); D.kitStrips(); D.eq(); D.amp();
  // each card's Tone button shows that player in the EQ and brings it into view
  [[cBass, "bass"], [cComp, "comp"], [cSecond, "comp2"], [cDrums, "drums"]].forEach(function(p){ p[0].firstChild.appendChild(D.toneButton(p[1], "Tone")); });
  D.onTone = function(){ tone.style.scrollMarginTop = "5rem"; tone.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); };
})();
</script>
```
